We work with lenders and financial institutions on one of the largest problems in fintech: failed payments. Americans owe $18.8 trillion, and lenders collect through a network that moved $31.7 trillion in debits last year. When a payment fails, the cause is most often simple: the money wasn’t in the account that day. The lender loses the payment, the borrower is charged a fee for a payment they meant to make, and everyone handles a return that never needed to happen. Rightfoot takes the guesswork out of payment timing. Our credential-less, real-time bank and debit card data lets lenders send each payment when it will clear. In the last 12 months we helped lenders identify more than $50M in available funds and helped lenders and borrowers avoid more than $12M in failed payment fees.
